# 3rdBrain by Qbyx Studio

## How this base works

* **One tool = one page**, filed in its topic category.
* The page body says what it is: 🧩 skill · 📦 repo · 🤖 model · 📝 prompt · ℹ️ reference.
* Full prompts stay whole on one page. Copy them as one piece.
* Looking for something? Start at the [Tool Index](tool-index.md), or
  [browse by facet](facets.md).

Categories grow from what you send. This page is yours to rewrite.
